_note: Exploratory, uncalibrated assumptions: every numerical value is a modeling choice, not an empirical estimate, unless a source is cited. Carbon-neutrality claims here mean overstating progress toward net-zero relative to actual emissions reductions or offsets, consistent with greenwashing literature. The 0-100 score and higher-is-preferred direction are conventions for a latent transition attribute, not a measured carbon intensity or a claim that higher scores are socially optimal. Sources establish terminology and context only; they do not calibrate model parameters. Equal size cost multipliers avoid assuming a large-firm cost advantage. This configuration tests the disclosure-game mechanism on a second domain, not external validity or policy effectiveness.
